title: Products in the relative section kernel vanish
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], J ≤ I quasi-coherent ideal sheaves with I*I ≤ J [def-sbc-ideal-sheaf-powers]. On any etale J-subscheme object V, two global sections a,b of its structure ring [def-sc-gm-torsor] that restrict to zero after pullback to the I-subscheme satisfy a*b=0.

proof.text: Over an affine chart Spec A of X, the two subschemes are Spec(A/I) and Spec(A/J). The ideal of the former in the latter is I/J. Its square is zero since I*I ≤ J. For any affine chart Spec C of an etale object mapping into this chart, the base-changed closed subscheme is defined by the ideal generated by the image of I/J in C. Products of generators vanish and thus this ideal has square zero. A section restricting to zero belongs to this ideal on every such affine chart. Consequently the restrictions of a*b to all these charts are zero. Since these charts cover the etale object, the separatedness of the structure sheaf implies a*b=0. The same argument handles I=J, zero ideals, and empty charts.

lean.statement:
theorem squareZeroRelativeSectionKernel (X : Scheme.{u})
    (I J : X.IdealSheafData) (hJI : J ≤ I) (hII : I * I ≤ J)
    (V : J.subscheme.Etaleᵒᵖ) (a b : J.subscheme.etaleStructurePresheaf.obj V)
    (ha : (etaleStructurePresheafToPullback (IdealSheafData.inclusion hJI)).app V a = 0)
    (hb : (etaleStructurePresheafToPullback (IdealSheafData.inclusion hJI)).app V b = 0) :
    a * b = 0
